issues.evidence_summary: V1 liquidation requires an error-free liquidity result with shortfall > 0; pinned Comptroller source supports the predicate, and the sampled debt-free control returns shortfall=0. Three display-rounding examples are present. The hosted whitepaper V1 health residual is a separate unpublished correction.
Overview no longer promises unconditional redemption; market liquidity and account shortfall constraints are explicit.
Hosted Overview explains the liquidator action rather than automatic execution; transaction timing itself was not tested.

issues.issue: Net APY denominator and net worth
issues.evidence_summary: Fresh help-center article uses Total supply as the Net APY denominator and separately defines Net worth; contradictory reverse-income sentence is absent. Frontend metrics are not covered.

issues.issue: Refund examples include an extra 20 TRX
issues.evidence_summary: Fresh help-center examples use a 140 TRX reserve; six Decimal arithmetic controls give 140,104,80,44,120,84. Historical fee assumptions are not re-approved.
Both articles retain internal date conflicts. Historical effective dates need the activity/content owner; different activities do not remove each article’s internal conflict.
All nine articles still describe four levels but list T1/T2/T3; the 50M equality boundary remains ambiguous. Historical rules need product confirmation.

issues.issue: Zero collateral factor and collateralizable wording
issues.evidence_summary: U and USD1 announcements still use collateralizable wording alongside 0% collateral factor. This is not a claim that the markets cannot supply or borrow.
Close factor is 0.5 of selected TRX debt 135 USD: maximum repay 67.5 USD, seize 72.9 USDC, leave 127.1 USDC, risk about 98.06; help-center example still repays 105 USD TRX.
100e6 / 1e8 is 1 jToken; redeemUnderlying(100e6) is 100 USDT in a 6-decimal market.
Ten Mainnet decimals() reads match the corrected table; token addresses and return words are recorded below.

Original human-facing targets already distinguish proxy and backend. Fresh Comptroller.oracle() and proxy.v1PriceOracle() confirm pointers; additional registry/LLM synchronization still awaits docs release.

issues.issue: sTRX quote precision and fractional input
issues.evidence_summary: Extracted quoteStake passes four fixed-rate raw-unit controls; SDK decimal conversion and exchangeRate boundary are mocked, not wallet transactions.
Payer path uses msg.sender and receiver; receiver path uses renter and msg.sender. The selected returnResource ABI parameter name is now compiler-aligned.
claimRental is an sTRX-only write returning this transfer in sun; rentClaimed is the cumulative read. Bytecode-matched source and historical RentClaimed receipt support the interpretation.
Fresh incentive=1.08e18 and close factor=0.5e18 are distinct; the existing Returns definition is already corrected.
Selected input/output signatures match the node ABI. Receipt components come from pinned official source, not a reproduced deployment compiler artifact.
Both Jump Rate branches use borrow_rate; supply_rate is separately defined.
jTRX ABI has repayBorrow(uint256) payable without a return and repayBorrowBehalf(address) payable; not a no-argument replacement.
Fresh plain and address-query requests both return all 24 markets with jTRX first; client exact-address lookup and failure controls are present.

issues.issue: MCP chain writes versus local configuration
issues.evidence_summary: Nine named tool classes explicitly disclose transaction/sign/broadcast paths; local config and the disabled bridge remain separate. Server code is not changed.
Fresh public API reports zero debt and health=0; the read-only liquidity query reports error=0/shortfall=0. Docs and YAML use debt-first interpretation.
Fresh API has supplyRate, no supplyApy; mining response is keyed by jToken then reward token. Text now says miningApy is a local variable, not a literal response field.

Both rates, threshold, dynamic fee and integer rounding are covered by documentation controls. Separate frontend review found the factors already present, but acceptance is not complete and the RPC failure path remains outside this PR.
2e26 with 18-decimal underlying/8-decimal jToken means 0.02 whole tokens; 0.02e18 means 2000000 underlying raw units per whole jToken.
Repository voting-weight/available-balance/explicit unlock explanations are corrected. Official PDF page 15 still has per-holder wording; local review copy is not publication.
Fresh Risks page checks inbox/spam/address, not user outbox. Real email delivery is not tested.
Fresh V1/V2 comparison permits multiple simultaneous V1 deposits; actual multi-position UI testing is not required to close the wording defect.

issues.issue: V2 LTV LLTV and risk ratio
issues.evidence_summary: Text distinguishes LTV > LLTV and risk > 1, with rounded values not an execution predicate. Exact integer-rounding boundary transactions were not tested; the official PDF V2 wording already uses a strict greater-than boundary.

Seven selected interfaces now match 109 node/compiler/source-backed entries after correcting five MarketG1 return definitions and two incomplete prose event signatures. Complete public source/deployment artifacts, admin and historical ABI coverage remain gaps.
